chunks: And from him, from Faḍālah, from Ibn Sinān, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abī ʿAbdillāh, Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام
key_terms.ابْنِ سِنَانٍ: Ibn Sinān, a narrator transmitting the report
key_terms.فَضَالَةَ: Faḍālah, a narrator in the sanad/isnad
key_terms.مِثْلَهُ: meaning that this report is the same as the preceding one in wording or ruling

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith in al-Istibsār support the ruling about a well into which a mouse, gecko, or leprous creature has fallen?
ai.summary: This report provides a sanad/isnad leading to Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام and indicates that the wording or ruling is the same as the previous hadith. In context, it serves as a supporting transmission for the same jurisprudential ruling discussed in the chapter.
